normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gated Community with on-site Security- Golf cart- Located on boardwalk - 2 minute walk to the beach- Private pool *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $50 per day.- 6 adult bikes- Gulf views- Lookout tower- Cocktail and lounge area- Game room- From March 1st to October 31st, 2024, the rental of this property includes one beach service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella)- Private Deeded Beach Access- Free WiFi- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout This home permits a maximum of 3 vehicles through the community security gate.DETAILS: Get away to The Rose of WaterSound Beach, a captivating 6-bedroom, 6.5-bathroom home that accommodates up to 14 guests. This premier gated community is the epitome of Gulf-front leisure and luxury, with winding boardwalks, rolling dunes, and deeded beach access. Guests will love lounging by the private pool, sipping drinks on the lookout tower, or hitting the beach—a 2-minute walk away!Natural light and illustrious design exude coastal elegance throughout this impressive 4-story haven. A graceful tongue-and-groove ceiling stretches above the ground level’s open-concept living area, beckoning guests to gather with friends and family. The living space hosts an intimate arrangement of 4 barrel chairs and a plush couch. A long bench and 5 chairs offer seating around the dining table for seafood feasts, with 2 extra seats at the breakfast bar. The beautiful chef’s kitchen seamlessly connects to the living and dining areas for flowing conversation and features glistening countertops and top-of-the-line appliances. Steps away, a private outdoor retreat awaits with a heated pool and plenty of deck space for entertaining. Take advantage of the charming weather with both the screened-in sitting porch and Summer kitchen with a gas grill. For sleeping accommodations, this level has 1 guest bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom.Discover 2 guest bedrooms and 2 primary bedrooms, all with king beds and private bathrooms on the second level.Enjoy evenings in the third-floor game room with a cozy reading nook, before heading down the hall to the kid-friendly bunk room with 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds.Mix a pitcher of fresh sangria and venture up to the lookout tower to drink in the Gulf view from the 4-seat table or recline on the outdoor sofa in the balmy breeze.Multiple indoor and outdoor space, a private pool, and a stellar location minutes from the beach make The Rose of WaterSound perfect for a remarkable beach escape. Easily explore with parking for 3 vehicles—plus 6 complimentary adult bikes and a 4-passenger golf cart. Book this home today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 14):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed and Queen Sleeper Sofa, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower only- Additional Living Area: Game Room and Reading NookFOURTH FLOOR:-Cocktail Lounge Area with Gulf Views*Weddings or parties/groups of people or guest of guest are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.*The fireplaces are not for guest use.

body_text_excerpt: Destination Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Watersound 27 Compass Rose Way Watersound, FL Bedrooms 6 Beds 9 Sleeps 14 Full Baths 6 Half Baths 1 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Gated Community with on-site Security - Golf cart - Located on boardwalk - 2 minute walk to the beach - Private pool *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $50 per day. - 6 adult bikes - Gulf views - Lookout tower - Cocktail and lounge area - Game room - From March 1st to October 31st, 2024, the rental of this property includes one beach service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella) - Private Deeded Beach Access - Free WiFi - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout This home permits a maximum of 3 vehicles through the community security gate. DETAILS: Get away to The Rose of WaterSound Beach, a captivating 6-bedroom, 6.5-bathroom home that accommodates up to 14 guests. This premier gated community is the epitome of Gulf-front leisure and luxury, with winding boardwalks, rolling dunes, and deeded beach access. Guests will love lounging by the private pool, sipping drinks on the lookout tower, or hitting the beach—a 2-minute walk away! Natural light and illustrious design exude coastal elegance throughout this impressive 4-story haven. A graceful tongue-and-groove ceiling stretches above the ground level’s open-concept living area, beckoning guests to gather with friends and family. The living space hosts an intimate arrangement of 4 barrel chairs and a plush couch. A long bench and 5 chairs offer seating around the dining table for seafood feasts, with 2 extra seats at the breakfast bar. The beautiful chef’s kitchen seamlessly connects to the living and dining areas for flowing conversation and features glistening countertops and top-of-the-line appliances. Steps away, a private outdoor retreat awaits with a heated pool and plenty of deck space for entertaining. Take advantage of the charming weather with both the screened-in sitting porch and Summer kitchen with a gas grill. For sleeping accommodations, this level has 1 guest bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom. Discover 2 guest bedrooms and 2 primary bedrooms, all with king beds and private bathrooms on the second level. Enjoy evenings in the third-floor game room with a cozy reading nook, before heading down the hall to the kid-friendly bunk room with 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds. Mix a pitcher of fresh sangria and venture up to the lookout tower to drink in the Gulf view from the 4-seat table or recline on the outdoor sofa in the balmy breeze. Multiple indoor and outdoor space, a private pool, and a stellar location minutes from the beach make The Rose of WaterSound perfect for a remarkable beach escape. Easily explore with parking for 3 vehicles—plus 6 complimentary adult bikes and a 4-passenger golf cart. Book this home today! SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 14): FIRST FLOOR: - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only SECOND FLOOR: - Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only - Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo - Guest Bedroom: King Bed and Queen Sleeper Sofa, Private Bathroom with Shower Only THIRD FLOOR: - Guest Bedroom: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower only - Additional Living Area: Game Room and Reading Nook FOURTH FLOOR: -Cocktail Lounge Area with Gulf Views *Weddings or parties/groups of people or guest of guest are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines. *The fireplaces are not for guest use.
